name: plane_soft_rubber_press_slide_release_5n
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; not measured properties of a named commercial material.
material_label: Soft rubber-like solid, force-matched to 5 N
model_notes: Near-incompressible rubber approximation; all relaxation parameters need fitting.
Travel is chosen so the press ends at the measured 5 N load. 0.29 mm is specific to this gel/specimen pair and must be re-derived for another material.
Specimen trimmed to 52x28 mm, the smallest size keeping the 2 mm edge margin through the 10 mm slide.
Gel uses mixed u-P and the contact pair carries stabilization damping; both were validated by the 1 mm press in combined_20260911.
